Most records carry no dollar amount, so each documented program costs a quarter of the red-flag points instead of being counted as spending.

Transparency: Young Township has filed its annual audit and financial report with the Department of Community and Economic Development for FY 2025, the latest year most PA governments have filed. This is a check that the report was filed, not an opinion on its contents. The other five practices have not been checked yet, so they are left out of the score.
